From: Amy Lopez <amy.lopez@beaconhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: security_ops@beaconhealth.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG questionnaire + snapshot ask (timeline: Dec 6)

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Beacon Health is proceeding with a formal SIG intake and we need an "evidence snapshot" to feed into our procurement review by next Monday (Dec 6).

Can you provide the following items?
- Completed SIG questionnaire (we've attached the template we typically use; please return a completed copy).
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest) or an interim bridge if the full report is not public.
- High-level data flow diagram (redacted is OK) showing PHI handling boundaries, KMS usage, and any customer-controlled key paths.
- Examples of retention policy artifacts and an index of log sources for the past 12 months.

If SFTP upload is required for larger files or there is a secure intake portal you prefer, let me know. We need a primary contact for any follow-ups from our InfoSec (I'll loop them in after we receive the snapshot).

Appreciate a quick plan and ETA.

Best,
Amy Lopez
Senior Procurement Manager | Beacon Health Systems
security@beaconhealth.com

Attachment: beacon_sig_template.xlsx
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Lopez <amy.lopez@beaconhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + snapshot ask (timeline: Dec 6)

Hi Amy — thanks, and great to meet you yesterday.

We can deliver an evidence snapshot by Dec 3 to give your team time to review. Proposed contents:
- Completed SIG questionnaire (we'll use your template and flag any out-of-scope items).
- SOC 2 Type II (2025) PDF and a short Q&A about any recent control changes.
- A redacted data flow diagram (PNG) showing where PHI may traverse and AWS KMS usage (we'll redact tenant IDs).
- A table of log sources and retention buckets (cloudtrail, app logs, telemetry) with last 12 months sample links.
- KMS key provenance note (will include AWS KMS ARN patterns and rotation cadence).

For file transfer: we can upload to a time-limited, permissioned Google Drive folder or provide an SFTP endpoint (we use a hardened transfer node for larger bundles). Which do you prefer?

I'm looping in Kimberly (security deliveries) and Grace (compliance operations) to confirm artifacts and run the redaction pass.

Thanks — plan to send the Drive link and the completed SIG by Thu Nov 3 (typo: Dec 3) EOD PST.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Architect, Trust & Safety | Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Beacon Health evidence snapshot — taks and owners

Team — incoming SIG intake from Beacon Health (deal HB-2026-0442). Target delivery Dec 3 EOD PST. Required deliverables below. Please reply with availability and expected ETA for your piece.

1) SIG questionnaire completion (priyom will draft answers, Kimberly to review technical controls and provide any updated artifact pointers).
   - Owner: priyom_das / kimberly_park
2) SOC 2 Type II PDF (signed) and control change log (if any):
   - Owner: kimberly_park (pull from secure vault; confirm redaction for org-specific client names).
3) Data flow diagram & KMS proof (include ARN patterns, rotation notes, custody model):
   - Owner: jonas_weber (diagram) + grace_oconnor (KMS notes / retention policies)
4) Log index and sample extracts (cloudtrail, app_access, inference telemetry) — provide sanitized extracts and paths:
   - Owner: jonas_weber
5) Transfer method: we'll create a secure Drive folder with restricted access and time expiry; if Beacon prefers SFTP we can spin up a transfer node (expected extra 24h).

Notes:
- For redaction, follow the standard compliance redaction checklist (PII/customer names redacted; maintain control IDs).
- We should include a short cover memo that explains any in-scope exceptions and points to longer artifacts in the secure share.
- Kimberly: if SOC 2 contains vendor names in attachments, mark those as redaction-required and confirm the minimal disclosure.

Kimberly — can you confirm you have the 2025 SOC 2 signed PDF and the control change log? Jonas/Grace — can you run the data flow sketch and KMS proof by Tue Nov 30 EOD?

Thanks — I'll collate and send the Drive link once we have the completed questionnaire.

--
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Architect, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Thanks Priyom — that plan works. Drive link preferred (time-limited share).

A few clarifying Qs from our InfoSec (copied below):
- Will the SOC 2 include details on your change management ticketing system and retention times for telemetries?
- Can you provide an affirmation on customer-data encryption at rest with key separation (if customer-managed keys are not supported, please state explicitly)?
- For the log extracts: please do not include user identifiers on any PHI-related traces; pseudonymize where needed.

If you can include a short cover memo addressing these three bullets in the Drive folder, that will speed our triage.

Best,
Amy
Senior Procurement Manager | Beacon Health Systems
